feature: Production dependency repair for realtime workflow imports

flows.name: Install the production dependency graph
steps: Install with the committed pnpm lockfile in frozen mode
Resolve yjs from the frontend package
Resolve y-protocols/awareness from the frontend package
flows.expectedOutcome: Both directly imported packages are installed and resolvable

flows.name: Deploy through the canonical source
steps: Publish the dependency-only change to GitHub main
Wait for the GitHub-integrated Vercel production build
Read back the production health endpoint
flows.expectedOutcome: The canonical production deployment is READY and healthy

claims.description: The directly imported realtime collaboration packages are declared and resolvable
